message.content:
This is a fan with a self-contained electric motor of output not exceeding 125 W, so it falls in heading 8414. Subheading 8414.51 covers table, floor, wall, window, ceiling or roof fans with a self-contained electric motor of output not exceeding 125 W. The statistical suffix is the open question.

The 8414.51 subheadings are:
- 8414.51.30: Table, floor, wall, window, ceiling or roof fans, with a self-contained electric motor of an output not exceeding 125 W, wall, ceiling or roof fans
- 8414.51.60 and 8414.51.90: other

On the HTSUS breakdown, 8414.51.30 is "Table, floor, wall, window, ceiling or roof fans, with a self-contained electric motor of an output not exceeding 125 W: Ceiling fans for permanent installation," and 8414.51.60 is "Other: Designed for permanent installation." Then 8414.51.90 is "Other", with 8414.51.9000 as its 10-digit number. The 8414.51.30 line is "Ceiling fans", 8414.51.60 is for fans of a kind with a "Box fans" description, and 8414.51.90 covers all other fans. This portable fan is not a ceiling fan and not a box fan, so it falls under the residual.

I recall CBP rulings on similar handheld or desktop fans classifying them under 8414.51.9000.
